For a pawn sitting on an edge rank — white pawn on rank 8 (e.g. `h8`), or black pawn on rank 1 (e.g. `h1`), the forward push computes a destination off the board (`h8` − 16 = `-9`). to = from + PAWN_OFFSETS[us][0]

```

## Summary

**Root cause:** In `Chess._moves` (src/chess.ts), the pawn **single/double push** logic lacked the off-board `to & 0x88` guard that the capture path already had. For a pawn sitting on an edge rank — white pawn on rank 8 (e.g. `h8`), or black pawn on rank 1 (e.g. `h1`), the forward push computes a destination off the board (`h8` − 16 = `-9`). Because `board[-9]` is `undefined` (treated as empty), `addMove` recorded a pseudo-legal move with an out-of-bounds `to`. During legal-move filtering, `_makeMove` → `_movePiece` called `_pieceKey(to)`, which returned `undefined` from the Zobrist `PIECE_KEYS` array; `_hash ^= undefined` then throws `TypeError: Cannot mix BigInt and other types`. (Had the push been on-board, `addMove` would correctly emit promotion moves.)

**Fix (minimal, style-consistent):** src/chess.ts:1578 — added `!(to & 0x88)` to the single-push guard, matching the off-board check the capture loop already uses:
```ts
to = from + PAWN_OFFSETS[us][0]
if (!(to & 0x88) && !this._board[to]) {
```
This makes edge-rank pawns generate zero forward moves; the double-push is nested inside so it's covered.
